notes: AGE-PRO Upper Scorpius 1. Transition disk with large inner dust cavity and ring at 78 au; ALMA residuals show a spiral arm and a tentative protoplanet candidate inside the cavity (Sierra et al. 2024; Vioque et al. 2025). SPHERE H-band imaging shows spirals, gap, and outer ring interpreted as evidence of planet-disk interaction (Ginski et al. 2025).
